name: smwsprites-piranha-sideways-v1
title: Piranha Sideways v1.0
description:
A piranha plant that comes out of horizontal pipes.

Uses first extra bit: YES
It's direction depends on the first extra bit. If it is set it will travel to the right to come out of the pipe. Otherwise it will travel left to come out of the pipe.
